name: Codex
notes: The Codex CLI ships inside ChatGPT.app on macOS, and the Windows Codex desktop app materializes it under %LOCALAPPDATA%/OpenAI/Codex/bin/<hash>/ (it also adds that dir to the user PATH, but GUI processes may hold a stale environment snapshot — hence the glob). Configuration is shared between Codex CLI, the desktop app's Codex surface, and the IDE extension.
